open_questions: No independent published total was retrieved for 1997, 2001 or 2005 Scotland: the api site publishes candidate votes and turnout but no valid vote count, and the Commons Library data (CBP-8647) was blocked. Those seats have valid_votes null and their national shares are unverified.

The 2005 notional national total (24,814,623) is published in the same file as the seat results, so it checks internal consistency only; no independent notional party totals exist in the retrieved sources.

2005n names only Con, Lab, LD, UKIP, Green, BNP, Plaid, the four big NI parties, Respect and Health Concern. Alliance (NI) and every other minor party are inside unknown_other, so 2005n 'alliance' is absent and 'green' is named in 190 seats only.
The Referendum Party (1997) is counted as 'other' rather than as UKIP's precursor.
NI Conservatives count as 'con' and Greens (NI) and Scottish Greens as 'green'.
The 1997-boundary Scotland and Northern Ireland codes (S1997…, N1997…) are the results database's own identifiers, not ONS codes.
The 1997, 2001 and 2005 Scotland results come from the api site's data file at a pinned commit; only 10 election pages and the three index pages were compared with it.
Downloaded HTML pages carry per-request tokens, so a fresh download of them has a different SHA-256; the pinned-commit files are reproducible.
